[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] maintained a '''laboratory''' in the [[Brell Sediment]], one of a series of facilities across the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] that Godera utilized. Godera was [[Battle in the Brell Sediment laboratory|captured]] by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] in that laboratory, and Intelligence's [[Watcher One]] ferried an unconscious Godera out of the lab when a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] arrived at the facility and engaged the [[Imperial soldier]]s present.
